'''DNM-908''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] in the service of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]]<ref name="GB" /> served as a [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. Like other B1-Series battle droids, DNM-908 had [[Gender/Legends|masculine programming]],<ref name="GB" /> was 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="Databank" /> and wielded an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]].<ref name="Equipment" /> The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had [[Color/Legends|light tan]] plating with brown markings and was equipped with a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] that had an [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]] attached.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
DNM-908 appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. The droid was available as a unique unit that the player could use in custom-made scenarios, and their name could also appear as the name of a Trade Federation commander in the standard game mode. DNM-908's in-game model is identical to other battle droid commander characters and has several differences from their profile image, featuring the tan color common to other B1 battle droids on their head and parts of their [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], along with the player's alignment color on their chest and legs.<ref name="GB" />
